content: By traversing $\mathbf {x}_1\mathbf {x}_2\cdots \mathbf {x}_n$ by order and reversely, we obtain the output features $\mathbf {h}_1^{\text{private}}\mathbf {h}_2^{\text{private}}\cdots \mathbf {h}_n^{\text{private}}$ of the bi-LSTM, where $\mathbf {h}_t^{\text{private}} = \overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_t \oplus \overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_t $ . Here we refer this Bi-LSTM as private in order to differentiate it with the common Bi-LSTM over the same character inputs which will be introduced in the next section.
